recent_calls.summary: The user called to report that the work order they received from a technician had the wrong customer's name on it. The agent acknowledged the issue and transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

Judy called to report that her air conditioning, which was cleaned last week, has stopped working again and there are medical conditions in the home requiring immediate attention. The agent flagged the request as urgent and informed Judy that the team will contact her on the next business day, which includes Saturday. Judy confirmed no further assistance was needed.

The user called after hours and requested to speak with a live person. The virtual assistant explained that live support was unavailable but offered to take a message for follow-up. The user declined and decided to call back during regular business hours.

The user, Cindy Phipps, scheduled a service appointment for her central air unit that is leaking and not cooling, requesting the earliest possible time on Monday. The agent confirmed her details and informed her that the team would contact her to confirm the appointment. Cindy declined information about maintenance programs and providing feedback.

The user, Sunitha, called after hours requesting estimates for installing a return vent in a bedroom and cleaning a vent at 400 Wild Oak Drive. The agent documented the requests and informed Sunitha that a team member would follow up on the next business day. The call ended with the user declining further assistance.
The call was very brief and disconnected almost immediately after the agent introduced herself. No meaningful conversation took place.

The user, Kim, called to report that their cooling system is not cooling the house properly and there is a possible issue with the fuse box. The agent booked an emergency service appointment for Monday, August 17th at 8 AM. The user declined to provide feedback due to being in a rush.

The call was an automated message from Hazel Woods School District reminding families about upcoming orientation nights at various schools. The user listened to the message and then opted out of future messages by calling the provided number. No further interaction with an agent occurred.

The user, Rondarius Washington, called to check the status of an appointment. The agent was unable to find any appointment under the user's information and offered to leave a message or transfer to a live representative. The user requested a transfer, and the agent successfully transferred the call to a live agent.
The user called to be connected with someone regarding a part delivery. The agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent who could assist further.

The user called to follow up on a callback regarding a part delivery. The agent attempted to assist but then transferred the call to a live agent for further help. The call ended with a successful transfer.

Benjamin called to schedule an AC service under his home warranty as his AC is not cooling. The agent confirmed the details and informed Benjamin that someone from Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing would contact him shortly. Benjamin declined information about maintenance programs and feedback requests.
The agent greeted the user and attempted to connect her with a live representative. The call was transferred successfully to another agent for further assistance.

The user called to reschedule an appointment but did not provide a description of the issue despite the agent's request. The call ended without the reschedule being processed due to lack of information.
The user called and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent did not engage in a detailed conversation but facilitated the transfer successfully.

The user, Jeffrey Hirston, called to schedule a standard service appointment for a water heater that is not producing hot water, possibly due to the thermocouple. The agent confirmed the details and informed Jeffrey that no slots were available for the requested day, offering alternative dates instead. The call ended with the agent transferring Jeffrey to a live agent for further assistance.
The user requested to speak with a live person, and the agent promptly initiated a call transfer to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully within a short call duration.
The user called and requested to speak with a live agent. The initial agent, Sophie, promptly transferred the call to a live agent as requested.
The user called and requested to speak to a specific person, C G. The agent attempted to connect the user and successfully transferred the call to the appropriate number.
The user informed the agent that they were home for the appointment. The agent then proceeded to transfer the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called Budget and was initially greeted by an automated agent requesting their service address ZIP code. The user requested to speak to a human, and the call was successfully transferred to a live agent.

The user called to set an appointment for air conditioning service through American Home Shield. The agent collected all necessary details including the property manager's contact and confirmed the information. The user requested to receive information about home maintenance programs via email and provided feedback about initial call difficulties but was satisfied with the service once connected.
The user called to set an appointment and provided their ZIP code. The call ended abruptly after the user requested to set an appointment and said "Hello?" without further interaction.

The user called to request an update on their order. The agent acknowledged the request and assured the user that a human agent would follow up with the latest details. The user did not request any changes or additional information.

The user called to inform about a new dispatch from American Home Shield and requested the agent to contact the property manager to arrange an appointment. The user offered to provide the dispatch number but the call ended abruptly without further action.

Ray Webb called to schedule a service appointment for his air conditioner, which is blowing but not cooling. The agent confirmed the home warranty coverage, collected the correct service address, and booked a technician visit for the same day at 4 PM. The call ended with the appointment successfully booked and no further requests from the user.
The user received a call from the agent but was on another phone and apologized. The agent then transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.
The user requested to speak with Amy, and the agent transferred the call to the appropriate person successfully.

Michael Johnson called to schedule a service appointment for his upstairs air conditioner, which is not blowing cold air. The agent collected all necessary details including service address, contact information, and preferred appointment times. The call ended with the agent confirming the information and informing Michael that someone from Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing would contact him shortly.
The user provided their ZIP code and requested to speak with a live representative. The agent confirmed the information and successfully transferred the call to a live agent.

The user called to report an AC issue covered under a home warranty and scheduled a technician visit for the same day. The agent confirmed the service details and informed the user that someone from Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing would contact them soon. The user declined information about maintenance programs and feedback requests.

The user called Budget asking to speak with Daniel. The agent, Sophie, informed the user that Daniel was unavailable but took a message for him to call back at the user's number. The call was then transferred to another agent for further assistance.

The user inquired whether the technician visiting could discuss replacement options, and the agent confirmed that the technician could provide information and quotes on upgrades or full system replacements. The user did not have further questions and ended the call politely.

Rob called to schedule a reinspection for an HVAC residential replacement at 37 Jost Villa Drive in Florissant, Missouri. The agent confirmed the details and available time slots, but Rob requested to speak to a live person, leading to a call transfer. The call ended with the transfer to another agent.

The user called to inquire about a previous air conditioning service and was transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The agent collected the user's service address, name, and contact information before initiating the transfer. The call ended with a successful transfer to another agent.

The user called asking to speak with Nicole or Cece, but the agent explained that direct transfers were not possible. The agent then attempted to transfer the call to another live agent who could assist further, and the transfer was successful.
The user requested to speak with a representative, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance. The call lasted 14 seconds and ended with a successful transfer.

The user called to inquire about the status of a recent repair done by a technician at their property, seeking confirmation if the issue was fully resolved or if further parts were needed. The agent acknowledged the concern and transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance. The call ended with a successful transfer.
The user called back after missing a previous call and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent facilitated the transfer without any issues.

The user called and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent, Sophie, greeted the user and then initiated a call transfer without completing a detailed conversation.

Jeffrey Thompson called to check if he had an air conditioner appointment scheduled for the day. The agent confirmed his details but found no appointment and offered to leave a message or transfer him to a live representative. Jeffrey chose to be transferred, and the call was successfully transferred to a live agent.
The call was very brief and disconnected shortly after the agent introduced herself. The user did not provide any clear information or request during the call.

Sandra called about her air conditioning unit not coming on after a power outage and needing urgent attention due to expected heat. The agent documented the issue, flagged it as urgent, and informed Sandra that a team member will contact her on the next business day. The call ended with Sandra understanding the situation and no further questions.

Rob, a mechanical inspector for Saint Louis County, called to request a final mechanical inspection at 37 Jost Villa Drive, Florissant, Missouri. The agent informed him that since it was after hours, they could not connect him to a live agent but documented his request for a team to call back on the next business day. The call ended with no further requests from Rob.

The user called Budget's after-hours assistant requesting a callback as soon as possible and provided their phone number. The call was brief and ended with the user hanging up after giving their contact information.

Jeffrey Thompson called to schedule service for his air conditioner, which was blowing warm air. The agent collected all necessary details, confirmed the service request, and informed Jeffrey that the team would follow up to confirm availability. Jeffrey declined information about maintenance programs and provided positive feedback about the call experience.

The user reported a cooling unit that is not turning on and requested immediate service. The agent collected the user's details, confirmed the service address, and noted the user's interest in receiving information about home maintenance programs. The call ended with the agent confirming that the service team will follow up soon.

The user reported that their air conditioner was not blowing cold air and requested a service appointment for the next morning. The agent confirmed the service details, including the address and callback number, and informed the user that the team would contact them on the next business day to confirm availability. The user declined information about maintenance programs and feedback requests.
